$comment: #185: scoring profile sets, read by lib/scoring-profiles.ts. Nothing in the publish path reads this file: the engine still scores with ALGORITHM_V76_WEIGHTS, and activeProfileSet records that v7.10 is the published set. Weights are fractions. A set with status legacy is frozen, has the one profile all for every tool, and may declare a total other than 1.00; every other set routes each tool to the profile named after its tools.kind and must declare 1.00. A profile with provisional set awaits the ruling it names. #186: publicNote true marks a provisional profile whose list page carries a public note (D54); the active set may hold a provisional profile only when it is productivity with publicNote true.

v7.10.label: v7.10
v7.10.description: Published v7.10 weights, one table for every tool. Weights unchanged since v7.6 (81c6b1d1); v7.10 is the info.technical / info.business fold in engine code (#101, 4e8b329a). Sums to 1.02 (#92); kept as-is so D45 can compare against it.

v8.0.label: v8.0
v8.0.description: Staged v8 profiles, routed by tools.kind. harness: ruling D44 (technical and adoption each 0.18 -> 0.17, other factors unchanged, sum 1.00). model: ruling D4b, signed off by the owner under D9b. productivity and other: the D44 harness weights, pending an Architect decision. Open-weight status is not a factor (D2f). Not selected by the publish path.

productivity.provisional: D44 harness weights, pending an Architect decision on the productivity profile

other.provisional: D44 harness weights, pending an Architect decision on the other profile
